interpretation.decision: Describe cost/coverage and cost per solve; target at least10% lower cost with at most2 lost solves per40, averaged over replicates. No significance gate or replacement attempts.
interpretation.estimand: Exact original controller with a smaller outer spending allowance, preserving observed cached responses and actual cache charges. Each arm gets the same cap. Also compare the cost/coverage frontier across caps.
interpretation.limitations: Conditional on the recorded trajectories, responses and cache behavior; not independent evidence of model reproducibility and not a new test sample. A stopping allowance is not a hard billing ceiling.
interpretation.scope: Both development partitions, two replicates; frozen books only. Online controls supply frozen A0/B0 train cells.
interpretation.security: HTTP disabled, immutable paid cache hashes, no new calls or proof synthesis; retained proofs must equal the original certified proof.
